hooks.text: NASA smashed an 820-pound copper probe into a speeding comet.
A NASA probe crashed into a speeding comet on purpose.
NASA fired an 820-pound missile into a comet at 23,000 mph.

title: NASA's 23,000 mph Comet Target Practice
description: NASA intentionally smashed an 820-pound copper probe into Comet Tempel 1 to study its interior.

beats.text: NASA smashed an 820-pound copper probe into a speeding comet.
beats.visual: Artist concept of Deep Impact probe approaching comet Tempel 1, 2005

beats.text: Many believed the spacecraft accidentally lost control and crashed.
beats.visual: Deep Impact spacecraft diagram showing flyby and impactor sections, 2005

beats.text: But engineers targeted comet Tempel 1 on purpose.
beats.visual: Telescope image of comet Tempel 1 nucleus before impact, 2005

beats.text: The probe slammed in at 23,000 miles per hour.
beats.visual: Artwork of Deep Impact probe striking the surface of comet Tempel 1, 2005

beats.text: It transmitted its final image just seconds before impact.

beats.text: Europe's Rosetta spacecraft filmed the crash from 80 million kilometers away.

beats.text: No malfunction occurred during this cosmic target practice.
